messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: elevated 5xx and timeouts on /v1/complete (global) — 8.7% errors over 5m. paging oncall
ravi: i'm oncall, looking. what region first?
claire: nyc and sfo edges showing spike; ingress-proxy 504s and connection resets from egress-proxy. seen it start about 22:12 UTC.
leo: i'm seeing a retry loop from the function-caller shim — it retries on 502 and keeps requeueing which amplifies load to egress. hooking logs.
taylor: can we flip off function-caller retries as a quick mitigation? that's a config flag at edge-runtime.
ops-bot: Note: deploy freeze in effect for prod between 22:00-23:00 UTC.
emma: CS: some users reporting slow responses; marking high priority for customers on dedicated clusters.
ravi: plan: 1) disable function-caller retry flag on edge-routes for /v1/complete; 2) scale egress-proxy up x2 in affected regions; 3) enable circuit-breaker on egress for 20s. who can push each?
leo: i'll push the edge-config override to disable retries. small, non-code change.
claire: i'll scale egress-proxy in nyc and sfo: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/egress-proxy --replicas=8`
leo: applying override now to nyc-canary then roll global if green.
deploy-bot: config-change queued by leo: edge-config v318 (function_retries=false for /v1/complete)
leo: canary applied in nyc-canary. watching metrics.
ops-bot: deploy freeze: exceptions allowed for urgent mitigations with incident lead approval. incident acknowledged by ops.
claire: scaled egress-proxy in nyc and sfo.
leo: canary looks good: errors down nyc-canary 15% -> 2.2% in 70s; proceeding to global roll.
deploy-bot: edge-config v318 rollout started -> regions: nyc, sfo, ewr, ams
ravi: enabling temporary circuit-breaker: `egress.cfg.circuit_breaker.threshold=300ms window=30s` applied in nyc and sfo.
emma: sending heads-up to CS with short note: "We're mitigating elevated 5xx/timeouts on completion endpoint, may see brief errors for some high-QPS customers."
leo: digging into root cause: function-caller shim began sending parallel subrequests per input after recent default change (shard=3). that increased concurrency to backend egress and uncovered connection pool exhaustion.
claire: logs show `connection_refused` and `dial tcp: lookup timeout` from egress-proxy when conns > 2000.
leo: we've got a small hotfix PR to expose `max_shards` and default it to 1 until we validate. PR: https://git.internal/r/edge/PR/987
ravi: good. after global roll, error rate trending down to 1.8% across regions. keep suppression for noisy paging alerts for 15m while we stabilize.
ops-bot: applied alert suppression: alert_id=egress-conn-count-high, suppress_duration=15m, note="incident 2031111111"
emma: CS update sent at 22:27 UTC.
leo: can we add an alert that watches shard-growth and egress connection velocity? will make a short-term alert.
claire: i've collected a snippet of the spike window for postmortem:
```
[2026-03-10T22:12:43Z] route=/v1/complete attempts=4 shards=3 egress_conn=2101 dial_err=timeout
[2026-03-10T22:12:44Z] upstream=egress-proxy error=504 latency=1204ms
```
taylor: immediate action items:
- leo: merge and canary PR to reduce default shards to 1 (owner)
- claire: add runbook section "egress connection exhaustion" with steps to scale egress, enable circuit-breaker, and suppress alerts (owner)
- ravi: update oncall playbook to include 'disable function-caller retries' as a quick mitigation (owner)
- emma: prepare customer-impact summary and CS template for postmortem (owner)
- taylor: create alert on egress.connection_velocity and shard.count growth (owner)
ravi: meeting in 60m to review timeline and decide if we need to roll back the function-caller change permanently.
leo: canary for PR 987 running in nyc-canary now. metrics look stable. will promote if green in 15m.
deploy-bot: canary deployment edge-shim v1.2.1 -> success in nyc-canary
ravi: ok all clear for now. leaving the thread open for 30 minutes for watch. thanks for quick responses — nice coordination. :mechanical_arm:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated. follow-up owners assigned.
